_comment: Each entry maps a slug to an HTML file in this repo. The sync sidecar reads this manifest and UPSERTs into the email_templates table (rows where source='git'). Marketing edits HTML; the manifest stays small.

templates.name: Free → Paid upgrade nudge
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Ready for more?
templates.description: Sent to free users who are hitting limits, nudging them to upgrade.

templates.name: Discount code
templates.subject: Remix IDE — A discount for you
templates.description: Sent when a discount/promo code is issued to a user.

templates.name: Welcome — Starter plan
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Welcome to Starter
templates.description: Sent when a user activates the Starter subscription.

templates.name: Welcome — Pro plan
templates.subject: Remix IDE — You just went Pro
templates.description: Sent when a user activates the Pro subscription.

templates.name: Credits running low
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Credits running low
templates.description: Sent when a user's AI credit balance falls below threshold.

templates.name: Renewal reminder
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Subscription renews soon
templates.description: Sent N days before a subscription auto-renews. Driven by the subscription.expiring_soon event.

templates.name: Subscription canceled
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Subscription canceled
templates.description: Confirmation email when a user cancels. Driven by the subscription.canceled event.

templates.name: Subscription expired
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Subscription ended
templates.description: Sent when a subscription term ends without renewal.

templates.name: Feature spotlight
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Have you tried the security agent?
templates.description: Periodic feature highlight email.

templates.name: Free-tier milestone recap
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Not bad.
templates.description: Encouragement email at usage milestones for free users.

templates.name: Beta — winding down
templates.subject: Remix IDE Beta Ending Soon: Claim Your 60% Discount
templates.description: Heads-up notice to beta users before beta ends.

templates.name: Beta ended + farewell discount
templates.subject: Remix IDE Beta Has Ended: Claim Your 60% Discount
templates.description: Sent when beta access ends, includes a launch-discount code.

templates.name: Welcome — generic signup
templates.subject: Welcome to Remix IDE
templates.description: Default welcome email on account creation.

templates.name: Credits purchased
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Credits added to your account
templates.description: Sent when a user purchases a credit top-up pack. Driven by the credits.purchased event.

templates.name: Subscription activated
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Subscription activated
templates.description: Sent when a subscription first activates. Driven by the subscription.activated event.

templates.name: Subscription renewed
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Subscription renewed
templates.description: Sent when a subscription advances into a new period. Driven by the subscription.renewed event.

templates.name: Feature access granted
templates.subject: Remix IDE — New access unlocked
templates.description: Sent when a user newly gains access to a feature group. Driven by the feature_membership.granted event.

templates.name: Feature access revoked
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Feature access ended
templates.description: Sent when a feature-group membership is revoked. Driven by the feature_membership.revoked event.

templates.name: Feature access expiring soon
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Feature access ending soon
templates.description: Sent ahead of a feature-group membership expiry as a renewal reminder. Driven by the feature_membership.expiring_soon lifecycle event.

templates.name: Feature access expired
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Feature access expired
templates.description: Sent when a feature-group membership reaches its expiry. Driven by the feature_membership.expired lifecycle event.

templates.name: Cancellation scheduled
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Cancellation scheduled
templates.description: Confirmation sent when a user schedules a cancellation. Access continues until the effective date. Driven by the subscription.cancellation_scheduled event.

variables.effective_date: Date the cancellation takes effect (from payload.effective_at)

templates.name: Subscription reactivated
templates.subject: Remix IDE — You're staying
templates.description: Confirmation sent when a user reverses a scheduled cancellation. The subscription keeps billing normally. Driven by the subscription.reactivated event.

templates.name: Subscription updated
templates.subject: Remix IDE — Subscription updated
templates.description: Sent when an active subscription is modified (plan change, quantity, or payment details) without advancing into a new billing period. Driven by the subscription.updated event.

templates.name: Abandoned credits checkout
templates.subject: Quick question about your Remix credits
templates.description: Friendly reminder sent when a user starts but does not complete a credit top-up checkout. Includes a resume link and invites feedback. Driven by the checkout.abandoned event (credits).

variables.resume_link: URL to resume the incomplete checkout (from payload.resume_link)

templates.name: Abandoned subscription checkout
templates.subject: Quick question about your Remix subscription
templates.description: Friendly reminder sent when a user starts but does not complete a subscription checkout. Includes a resume link and invites feedback. Driven by the checkout.abandoned event (subscription).

variables.plan_name: Plan display name (from payload.plan_slug or payload.plan_name)
variables.resume_link: URL to resume the incomplete checkout (from payload.resume_link)
